Fantasy Name Generator

Generate original fantasy names for characters and places — male, female, and location styles with short, medium, or long forms.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a style: male, female, or place.
  2. Choose name length and how many to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then tap any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are these names from books or games?

No — every name is built on the spot from original syllable banks, so you get fresh combinations, not copied characters.

Can I generate many names at once?

Yes. Choose 1, 10, or 25 names per click for brainstorming whole casts or maps.

How do I copy a name?

Click any generated name (or its Copy button) to copy it to your clipboard instantly.
